title: Choose the homepage's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Answer Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Answer Sheet
options.lineage: OMR answer sheets and exam form design
options.thesis: The exam's quiet grid discipline — numbered cells, fine rules, one ink — carried onto the page; the page behaves like the document you fill under time pressure.
options.viewport: A ruled form sheet: boxed title block, ink headline, a live 40-cell answer grid filling beside a timer.
options.risk: Form-filling reads bureaucratic if the ink is timid; needs a confident stamp.

raised.raise: Drafting annotation: the interface carries precise numeric callouts pinned like measurements — real numbers only (30 min, 40 questions, band scale).

options.label: The Interface Itself
options.thesis: The homepage is the exam screen: the real CD-IELTS interface, reproduced at full fidelity, is the hero; copy serves it, and the begin action sits in its chrome.
options.viewport: The exam interface at full width, one terse line above it, the begin action set into its chrome.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on — the product's own UI as hero.

options.label: The Specimen Document
options.thesis: The homepage as a precise examination document: ink text at a strict measure, guide words naming the span in view, and the page's only colour quarantined inside the bordered exam-interface plate.
options.viewport: A document spread: guide words on a head rule, a serif headword entry at measure, the only colour inside Plate I — the exam UI.
options.risk: Vintage if the serif dress is costume; must read as a modern document, not a period one.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the exam UI becomes the page's only colour plate — proof made focal; guide words structure the practice journey. Beats the assigned on identification and on clarity.

options.label: The Test-Day Board
options.thesis: The homepage as the test-centre departure board: every sitting a ruled row, states that restyle without breaking the grid, changes cascading letter by letter.
options.viewport: A full-bleed departure board of today's sittings, the headline set in flap cells, an amber take-seat action.
options.risk: Retro-device novelty, and a dark ground fights the light-first brief.
options.case: Holds identification — everyone knows the board's rhythm — but frames departure rather than exam fidelity, and 'subtle' is hard at full flap commitment.

options.label: The Section of a Test Day
options.viewport: A tall section drawing of test day, rooms read through a travelling beam, architect's lettering.
options.risk: Poetic but fails to prove exam fidelity.
options.case: Fuses poorly: sun paths do not carry the offer or the action.
options.kept: Drafting discipline — precise numeric callouts pinned to the interface (raised into the assigned direction).

reroll.note: Re-roll pool held back: paper-automata menagerie, numbered insert-card series, ASCII live-scene render.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline, CTA pair, three feature cards — the arrangement a visitor expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
